Comparison 0 has witness event 3 correlated to admission 2: producer value ballot 1 became decoded value ballot 0, with an empty decode error and zero remaining bytes. Events 0 and 1 are the same probe for producer value ballot 0 and match. Identity is the independently assigned case and source/instance tuple, not VBallot. Actual handlePropose creates the prior state, handlePrepare constructs the reply from inst.vbal, SendMsg calls the captured Marshal, and a fresh object decodes the resulting bytes as in replicaListener. The fixed codec contains no VBallot write or assignment. The applicable local responsibility is preservation of the prior value ballot needed by handlePrepareReply at lines 1239-1246; this conclusion does not require a chosen quorum. The reduced initialization omits runtime scheduling and capacity, neither of which changes this synchronous serializer endpoint.

experiment.prefix: Propose B at peer 1 and A at peer 0 on the same key. Deliver A preaccepts to peers 1 and 2 and their actual replies back to peer 0. Differing attributes cause the production slow transition and bcastAccept. Deliver those Accept messages, decode actual acknowledgments, sample acceptor status, and request Prepare using a fresh peer 3 recovery producer to inspect reported status.
experiment.requirement: An acceptor that handles a matching, non-stale Accept and emits its successful ballot acknowledgment must retain and report the accepted phase, so recovery can distinguish it from mere preacceptance.
experiment.responsibility: Local Accept processing and Prepare report phase preservation, before any assertion about a quorum or distributed safety consequence.
